children: Cracker Barrel guided for growth in the year ahead, forecasting revenue of about $3.33 billion to $3.4 billion, up from $3.32 billion for the year that ended July 31. The forecast comes after the restaurant chain tapped David Deno, the former CEO of Outback Steakhouse owner Bloomin' Brands, as its new CEO effective August 10. Deno succeeded Julie Masino, who had overseen Cracker Barrel's controversial rebranding campaign before walking back some of the changes. Deno says he is confident that the company's strategic priorities around food, experience and people will sustain its momentum. "The company is focused on the right areas and has a strong plan," he says. (kelly.cloonan@wsj.com)
